Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.console

package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.console
Engine-agnostic themeable admin-console chrome: Theme, the stock theme stylesheets, the bundled chrome.css asset, and ConsoleChromeMixin.

This module is CSS-serving only — it ships no template files and has no view-engine dependency. It is the module the per-engine FreeMarker (and, eventually, other) chrome add-ons build their template composition on top of.

Since:
10.0.0
